item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! Lovely to see you. It's Thursday, November 19. Time for the weather! It's Thursday, almost the end of the week. Today in Shanghai, it will be overcast. The warmest part of the day will be 11 degrees, and the coolest 4. A bit parky today, as they say. There is almost no chance of rain today. There are 35 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Wrap up warm today, with a big coat and cosy gloves! As for tomorrow, expect it to be overcast, with a high of 11 degrees. One more day of thinking about taking turns. What stands out? That's your weather. Have a wonderful day!
